appDescription: NPass is an offline password manager: your accounts are encrypted on your device and never leave it.
installApp: Install NPass, a free offline password manager
name: Name
tooManyAttemptsTryAgainLater: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
introTitle1: All your passwords in one place
introBody1: NPass keeps them in an encrypted vault on your phone.
introBody2: No account, no server: your data never leaves your device.
introBody3: Your master password unlocks the vault. It can't be recovered, so choose it carefully.
createVaultBody: It protects all your accounts. Prefer a long phrase that is easy for you to remember and hard to guess.
masterPasswordWarning: If you forget this password, your data will be lost: NPass can't recover it.
pleaseAcknowledge: Please tick this box to continue
biometricsEnableFailed: Biometrics could not be enabled. You can try again in the settings.
biometricsChanged: Biometrics changed on this device. Unlock with your master password, then enable them again in the settings.
forgotMasterPasswordBody: NPass doesn't know your master password and can't recover it. The only option is to erase the vault and start over: all your saved accounts will be lost.
eraseVaultConfirm: Permanently erase the vault and all your accounts? This can't be undone.
noEntriesHint: Add your first account with the + button.
copiedSecret: $field copied. It will be cleared from the clipboard in $seconds s.
deleteEntryConfirm: Delete "$title"? You can undo right after.
changeMasterPasswordBody: Your accounts stay encrypted with the same key: only the password that protects it changes.
sameAsCurrentPassword: The new password must differ from the current one
biometricsNotEnrolled: No fingerprint or face enrolled on this device
autoLockHint: Time in the background before the vault locks
revealPasswordsHint: In clear when opening an account
backupBody: A backup is a file encrypted with a password of your choice. Keep it off your phone (cloud, computer) to get your accounts back if you lose the device.
exportBackupHint: An encrypted file to keep somewhere safe
backupPasswordHint: You will need it to restore the backup. It can be your master password.
restoreBackupPasswordBody: Enter the password chosen when exporting.
invalidBackupFile: This file is not a valid NPass backup.
backupFromNewerVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of NPass. Update the app to restore it.
importMergeHint: Adds the backup accounts. An account already in the vault is only replaced by a more recent version.
importReplaceHint: Erases the current accounts and replaces them with the backup.
importReplaceConfirm: Erase the $accounts in the vault and replace them with the backup? This can't be undone.
shareFileHint: Send the file to another app
hiddenFieldHint: For a PIN code or a secret answer
passwordReusedHint: A different password for each account limits the damage of a leak.
effWordlistCredit: Passphrase wordlist: Electronic Frontier Foundation, CC BY 3.0 US
legacyNotice: NPass has existed since 2018. This version was fully rewritten, with modern encryption and no Internet connection at all.
totpSecretHint: The key the website shows when you turn on 2FA
invalidTotp: Invalid key: copy the key the website shows, or the otpauth:// link
scanQrHint: Point at the QR code the website shows when you turn on 2FA.
importImageHint: A screenshot of the QR code
notTotpQr: This QR code is not a 2FA code
noQrInImage: No readable QR code in this image
cameraDenied: NPass can't use the camera. Allow it in the phone settings, or import a screenshot of the QR code.
